47/G.goal: Explain how the implemented Majuli VR tour is evaluated and what its presence and cybersickness results indicate.
47/G.achieves: This gives the learner a case-study method for evaluating an implemented XR system and for recognizing presence and cybersickness issues that inform subsequent optimization work.

47/O1.goal: Explain how a controlled evaluation of the Majuli VR tour case study is set up and run.
47/O1.achieves: This lets the learner understand how an implemented XR system is empirically tested for presence, comfort, and usability, providing a basis for judging implementation quality before optimization.

47/O2.goal: Interpret the presence and cybersickness results of the Majuli VR tour evaluation.
47/O2.achieves: This lets the learner assess whether the implemented XR experience achieved immersion and acceptable physiological comfort, identifying issues that later optimization may address.
